title: Legacy SWAP groundwater-level versus lower-face-head semantics and current F-GC mapping

behavior: If groundwater level lies in or above the soil profile, the Richards domain is truncated/continued saturated relative to the groundwater level.
If groundwater level lies below the profile, the groundwater-level state is converted to a lower-face pressure head.
qbot is an output, not a prescribed forcing.

SWBOTB5.meaning: prescribed lower-face pressure head as a function of time
behavior: Lower-face pressure head hbot enters the Darcy bottom gradient.
The lower-face K/d term enters the Jacobian.
Accepted qbot is materialized from the accepted trajectory.
SWBOTB5.typed_status: RESTRICTED_PRODUCTION through groundwater-owned route, not a generic DATE5 application adapter

current_f_gc.corrector_mapping: MODFLOW/interface hydraulic head -> datum transform -> SWAP bottom_head under bottom_mode=5
current_f_gc.explicit_nonidentity: canonical bottom-face source states this coupling-plane head is not the freatic groundwater level

architectural_conclusion: A current F-GC mode-5 corrector and a legacy mode-1 prescribed-groundwater-level state machine are not the same physical coupling contract.
A true shared-phreatic h-link would require an explicit typed water-table/shared-storage contract, not merely reuse of the existing mode-5 lower-boundary head adapter.

The two contracts can approach equivalent behavior in special limits, for example a hydrostatic profile with negligible vertical resistance and consistent storage ownership, but that equivalence must be proven rather than assumed.
implications: Current F-GC MODFLOW STO and SWAP finite-window response need not be duplicate storage because current coupling is boundary based and the synthetic domains are not coextensive.
If SWAP5 later wants a SIMGRO-style complete-profile h-link, storage ownership and the phreatic state machine must be designed explicitly.
Legacy SWBOTB=1 is scientific lineage relevant to that future design, but its full state/timing semantics are currently not typed/admitted.
forbidden_inference: Do not replace current F-GC mode 5 by legacy mode 1 from this audit.
Do not claim mode 5 is physically wrong; it represents a different coupling family.
Do not claim mode 1 is production ready.
next: Preregister a transparent equivalence/nonequivalence test between shared-phreatic and lower-boundary-head models.
If future h-link development is desired, define a typed phreatic-state and complete-profile storage contract before implementation.
